name: VWAP reclaim: below VWAP for 30 minutes, then a 5-minute close back above
why: A reclaim of VWAP after the market traded below it means the session's sellers have been absorbed at a discount to the day's average price; VWAP-benchmarked buyers now chase. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_vwap_ema.md).

scan.when: (lag(30, px < vwap) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) < lag(5, vwap) && cl(5,1) > vwap) || (lag(30, px > vwap) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) > lag(5, vwap) && cl(5,1) < vwap)
scan.dir: (lag(30, px < vwap) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) < lag(5, vwap) && cl(5,1) > vwap) - (lag(30, px > vwap) && lag(5, cl(5,1)) > lag(5, vwap) && cl(5,1) < vwap)
